inventory_scope: All open pull requests returned by GitHub API state=open, pages 1..2, per_page=100.
limitations: This is a metadata-first triage inventory, not a line-by-line technical review of all 133 diffs.
CI and independent review are explicitly NOT_AUDITED_IN_THIS_INVENTORY; do not interpret them as passing or failing.
Area, priority and triage_class are deterministic heuristics based on title/body, age, draft state and base branch; a human maintainer must confirm.
No PR is merged or closed by this manifest.
Candidate SHA and live evidence must be rechecked at decision time.

disposition_policy.stacked_branch_rule: Resolve the base PR dependency first; validate merged stack order and conflict risk.
merge_gate: fresh evidence tied to exact candidate SHA
close_gate: scope absorbed in an identified canonical PR or commit
owner approval or clearly obsolete redundant work
